purpose: Repo-local OS Abyss artifact bundle input for generated/seed_route_map.min.json.

consumer_contract.consumer_expectation: Seed consumers select a dionysus_seed_route_readmodel_bundle from the registry latest read-model only after ABI verification, seed route validation, and seed-surface validation pass; the generated route map remains navigation, not seed canon or owner-repo landing proof.

consumer_command: abyss-machine artifacts bundle-register BUNDLE_DIR --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --lifecycle-state release-ready --json
abyss-machine artifacts trust-gate --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --artifact-class dionysus_seed_route_readmodel_bundle --consumer-intent agent --source-repo Dionysus --json
abyss-machine artifacts registry-latest --registry-dir REGISTRY_DIR --artifact-class dionysus_seed_route_readmodel_bundle --consumer-intent agent --source-repo Dionysus --json
